title: Rethinking Fine-Tuning when Scaling Test-Time Compute: Limiting Confidence Improves Mathematical Reasoning
authors_zh: Feng Chen、Allan Raventós、Nan Cheng、Surya Ganguli、Shaul Druckmann（机构：Stanford University、University of Michigan）
paper_type_zh: 测试时计算对齐的微调研究（NeurIPS 2025）
best_for_zh: 研究推理模型训练目标如何与 pass@N 或证明搜索预算共同设计的读者。
one_line: DCO aligns fine-tuning with a chosen pass@N test-time budget by limiting overconfidence and preserving useful answer diversity.
DCO 通过限制过度置信，使微调目标与预定的 pass@N 测试时采样预算对齐，并保留有用的答案多样性。
why: It demonstrates that a training loss optimized for one sample can reduce performance when the deployed system relies on many samples.
inclusion_reason: It directly studies how the training objective must change when the deployed system spends more test-time compute through pass@N sampling.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Fine-tuning is commonly optimized for the probability of one reference completion, while a deployed reasoning system may draw many independent completions and accept success when any one is correct. These objectives agree for pass@1 but need not agree at pass@N. Continued cross-entropy training can concentrate probability on a small number of answers; if a confident answer is wrong, repeated sampling may reproduce the same failure rather than provide the diverse attempts that make additional inference compute useful.

The paper asks how the training objective should depend on the intended test-time sampling budget. Its decision surface contains a prompt, a completion distribution, a training coverage target, N sampled completions at deployment, and a correctness predicate. The study tests whether standard cross-entropy is aligned with large-N coverage, identifies confidence as the mechanism of misalignment, and asks whether a loss designed for pass@N can preserve exploration without discarding the ability to exploit a high-confidence correct answer.

微调通常优化的是单个参考完成的概率，而部署中的推理系统可能会抽取许多独立完成，只要其中任意一个正确便接受成功。两种目标在 pass@1 时一致，却未必在 pass@N 时一致。持续的交叉熵训练会把概率集中到少数答案上；如果一个高度自信的答案恰好错误，重复采样可能只是复制同一失败，而不能提供让额外推理计算有价值的多样尝试。

论文研究训练目标应如何依赖预期的测试时采样预算。其决策表面包含提示、完成分布、训练覆盖目标、部署时抽取的 N 个完成，以及正确性判定。研究检验标准交叉熵是否与大 N 的覆盖率对齐，将置信度识别为错配机制，并询问一种为 pass@N 设计的损失能否在不放弃高置信正确答案利用能力的前提下保留探索。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central claim is that pass@N is a coverage objective, not merely an accuracy objective repeated N times. At a large budget, a useful model must allocate enough probability mass to multiple plausible answers so that a correct one can be reached by sampling. Cross-entropy optimized for pass@1 instead rewards making the observed completion increasingly dominant. When the model is uncertain and that dominant completion is wrong, this creates overconfidence and removes the exploration needed for coverage.

Direct Coverage Optimization, or DCO, optimizes the probability that a reference completion appears at least once in a specified number of samples. Its gradient is the ordinary cross-entropy gradient multiplied by an overconfidence-dependent attenuation factor, so examples the model already treats as very likely contribute less. The training coverage parameter becomes a control for the later sampling regime: small values favor concentrated exploitation, while larger values encourage broader exploration. The record therefore joins the training parameter with the deployment pass@N budget.

核心主张是，pass@N 是覆盖率目标，而不是把准确率目标重复 N 次。在较大预算下，有用的模型必须给多个合理答案分配足够概率质量，使正确答案能够通过采样被找到。为 pass@1 优化的交叉熵则奖励让观察到的完成越来越占主导。当模型不确定而这个主导完成又是错误的，它会造成过度置信，并移除覆盖率所需要的探索。

直接覆盖优化，即 DCO，优化的是在指定数量样本中至少一次产生参考完成的概率。它的梯度是普通交叉熵梯度乘以依赖过度置信的衰减因子，因此模型已经认为极可能的样本贡献更少。训练覆盖参数成为后续采样机制的控制量：较小取值偏向集中的利用，较大取值鼓励更广泛的探索。核心记录因此将训练参数与部署 pass@N 预算连接起来。

title: Method
方法
html:
For direct mathematical answers, the authors fine-tune Llama-3-8B-base on MATH and evaluate a verifier-backed pass@N protocol. They derive DCO from the probability of emitting the correct completion at least once in the chosen number of draws. DCO reduces to cross-entropy at one draw, but increasingly attenuates updates to already high-confidence examples as its coverage parameter grows. The paper trains multiple variants because no single setting is expected to be Pareto-optimal for every deployment N.

The method is also adapted to formal proof search. In LeanDojo, the model proposes a tactic from a proof state, Lean validates it and returns a next state, and search ends at an invalid tactic, a depth limit, or a completed proof. A step-wise DCO variant controls confidence at every proof step and thereby the effective branching width of the search tree. The paper evaluates direct answers, chain-of-thought answers using approximate confidence estimates, and proof search; reproduction must log loss parameter, sampling count, verifier, tree width and depth, model confidence, wall-clock cost, and outcome.

对于直接数学答案，作者在 MATH 上微调 Llama-3-8B-base，并评估由判定器支持的 pass@N 协议。他们从在指定抽取数量中至少一次生成正确完成的概率推导 DCO。DCO 在一次抽取时退化为交叉熵，但随着覆盖参数增大，会更强地衰减对已经高置信样本的更新。论文训练多个变体，因为任何单一设置都不可能对每个部署 N 都达到帕累托最优。

方法也被改写为形式化证明搜索。在 LeanDojo 中，模型从证明状态提出策略，Lean 验证策略并返回下一状态；搜索在无效策略、深度上限或完成证明时结束。逐步 DCO 变体控制每个证明步骤的置信度，从而控制搜索树的有效分支宽度。论文评估直接答案、使用近似置信度估计的思维链答案和证明搜索；复现必须记录损失参数、采样数、判定器、树宽与深度、模型置信度、实际运行成本和结果。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper first exposes the problem with a four-epoch Llama-3-8B MATH experiment. Cross-entropy raises pass@1 from 4.4% to 7.4%, but the reported pass@256 falls from 65.2% to 44.5% and pass@4k falls from 82.5% to 63.0%. This is direct evidence that better one-sample accuracy can coexist with worse large-budget coverage. The authors report that DCO variants form a stronger performance frontier when their training coverage parameter is close to the test-time sampling count.

For proof search, the reported pass@4k cross-entropy baseline obtains 55.6% on Mathlib and 37.4% on MiniF2F. An ensemble of step-wise DCO models reaches 62.2% and 43.6%, compared with a five-times-compute cross-entropy baseline at 57.0% and 39.5%. These findings support matching training confidence to a search regime, but remain evidence for the tested models, data, verifiers, and sampling budgets; the paper itself shows that choosing a DCO setting too large or too small for the deployment N can move performance below the frontier.

论文首先用一个四轮 Llama-3-8B 的 MATH 实验展示问题。交叉熵将 pass@1 从 4.4% 提高到 7.4%，但报告的 pass@256 从 65.2% 降至 44.5%，pass@4k 从 82.5% 降至 63.0%。这是直接证据，表明更好的一样本准确率能够与更差的大预算覆盖率并存。作者报告，当 DCO 的训练覆盖参数接近测试时采样数时，多个 DCO 变体形成更强的性能前沿。

对于证明搜索，报告的 pass@4k 交叉熵基线在 Mathlib 上为 55.6%，在 MiniF2F 上为 37.4%。逐步 DCO 模型的集成达到 62.2% 和 43.6%，而使用五倍计算的交叉熵基线为 57.0% 和 39.5%。这些发现支持让训练置信度匹配搜索机制，但仍只是对所测试模型、数据、判定器和采样预算的证据；论文本身表明，若为部署 N 选择的 DCO 设置过大或过小，性能会落在前沿之下。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest test-time methods increase the number of sampled answers, apply a verifier, or change the search tree after a conventional fine-tuning stage. This paper changes the training objective itself so that the model distribution is prepared for the intended number of test-time attempts. It identifies an explicit failure mode of treating one-sample likelihood as the sole training target: the policy can become confidently wrong and lose the answer diversity that pass@N needs.

The reusable novelty is the parameterized bridge between a training coverage objective and an inference coverage objective. In proof search, the step-wise formulation further makes the training parameter a way to shape depth-versus-width exploration. The work does not claim one universal confidence level or one loss that dominates every test-time strategy. Rather, it establishes that the deployed sampling budget is part of the training specification and must be recorded when comparing post-training procedures.

最接近的测试时方法会增加抽取答案数量、使用判定器，或在常规微调后改变搜索树。本论文改变训练目标本身，使模型分布为预期数量的测试时尝试做好准备。它识别出只把单样本似然当作训练目标的明确失败模式：策略可能变得高度自信但错误，并失去 pass@N 所需的答案多样性。

可复用的新意是训练覆盖目标与推理覆盖目标之间的参数化桥梁。在证明搜索中，逐步形式还使训练参数能够塑造深度与宽度之间的探索。该工作并未宣称存在一个普适置信度或一种损失能支配所有测试时策略；它建立的是，部署采样预算是训练规范的一部分，比较后训练程序时必须记录这一点。

title: Limitations
局限
html: DCO needs a clear correctness signal and an anticipated pass@N regime, so it is easiest to apply to mathematics, code, or formal tasks with efficient verification. Matching one training parameter to one deployment budget yields no single model that is optimal across all budgets; approximate confidence for chain-of-thought adds estimator error, and high-N sampling can still be expensive. The reported results use particular base models, datasets, and proof environments, while the method’s confidence interpretation assumes that model confidence is related to answer correctness. Deployment should therefore validate calibration, diversity, verifier reliability, and real serving cost rather than infer them from loss curves alone.

DCO 需要清晰的正确性信号和预先设定的 pass@N 机制，因此最容易应用于具有高效验证的数学、代码或形式化任务。把一个训练参数匹配到一个部署预算，并不能得到对所有预算都最优的单一模型；思维链的近似置信度会加入估计误差，而高 N 采样仍可能昂贵。报告结果使用的是特定基础模型、数据集和证明环境，方法对置信度的解释还假设模型置信度与答案正确性相关。因此，部署时应验证校准、多样性、判定器可靠性和真实服务成本，而不能只从损失曲线推断它们。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when a system deliberately pays for multiple independent attempts or a verifier-guided search tree. Store the intended N with the model checkpoint, then log prompt, samples, answer or tactic probability, entropy or confidence, verifier result, candidate diversity, tree width and depth if applicable, pass@N, tokens, latency, and cost. Compare cross-entropy and coverage-trained models at matched verifier and total sampling budgets. If production must serve several N values, maintain a coverage-trained portfolio or measure a routing policy rather than assuming one model will optimize every budget.

当系统刻意为多个独立尝试或判定器引导的搜索树付费时，本论文很有用。应将预期的 N 与模型检查点一起保存，并记录提示、样本、答案或策略概率、熵或置信度、判定器结果、候选多样性、若适用则树宽与深度、pass@N、token、延迟和成本。应在匹配的判定器和总采样预算下比较交叉熵模型与覆盖率训练模型。如果生产系统必须服务多个 N 值，应维护覆盖率训练的模型组合或测量路由策略，而不是假设一个模型能够优化每种预算。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the coverage metric, the confidence analysis, and the deployment budget as one argument. The most important comparison is not DCO versus cross-entropy at an arbitrary N, but whether the training coverage parameter and test-time N are matched. Then separate direct-answer experiments from theorem-proof search, where the parameter also changes effective tree shape. The MATH table is especially instructive: pass@1 improves while high-N coverage worsens. It is a warning to evaluate an inference-scaling system with the actual decision rule it will use, rather than with a convenient one-sample proxy.
应把覆盖率指标、置信度分析和部署预算作为同一个论证来读。最重要的比较不是在任意 N 下比较 DCO 与交叉熵，而是训练覆盖参数与测试时 N 是否匹配。随后应区分直接答案实验与定理证明搜索；在后者中，该参数还会改变有效树形。MATH 表格尤其具有启发性：pass@1 改善，而高 N 覆盖率变差。它警示我们，应使用推理扩展系统实际采用的决策规则进行评估，而不是使用方便的一样本代理。
